paragraphs.prose: I am excited to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer role at Harbor & Pine. With four years of experience building API-driven products, I bring a backend-leaning approach focused on clean service boundaries, practical system design, and dependable delivery.

requirements.text: 3–5 years of experience building production APIs with Python

evidence.text: Backend-leaning full-stack engineer with 4 years of experience building API-driven products, focused on clean service boundaries, cost-aware system design, and shipping things that hold up under real traffic.

paragraphs.prose: In my current Software Engineer role at Northlight Analytics, I redesigned a monolithic reporting service into per-tenant async jobs, reducing p95 report generation time from 40 seconds to 6 seconds. I also introduced typed request/response models across the API layer and built rate-limiting middleware after a partner integration caused a cost spike.

I would also bring relevant experience for Harbor & Pine’s retail customers. I built and maintained a Django/PostgreSQL inventory system serving more than 200 retail locations, and migrated a legacy jQuery dashboard to React. That background gives me a useful perspective on dependable tools for retail teams, while my Docker and REST API design experience would transfer well to the role’s platform work.

evidence.text: Built and maintained a Django/PostgreSQL inventory system serving 200+ retail locations

paragraphs.prose: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I could contribute to Harbor & Pine’s engineering team. Thank you for your consideration.
